summary: While checking on a household in {place}, an outreach worker asks whether it needs help restoring heat.
realLife: Sandy outreach teams identified homes for Rapid Repairs while checking on residents and distributing supplies.
gates: A storm outreach team can refer homes to a local repair program.
inGame: needs: a storm outreach team can refer homes to a local repair program.

turns.pulledBy: The household asks for repair help.
turns.what: Send a referral and leave the program contact.
turns.writesBack: The repair program receives a household referral.

turns.pulledBy: The household reports heat is back.
turns.what: Record the restored service before closing the visit.
turns.writesBack: The outreach record reflects the household's report.
